newsitem.title: USA: Dow seen opening lower as correction continues.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen opening lower as correction continues.

text.p: U.S. stocks are expected to open lower on Friday, continuing the two-day sell-off that has seen the Dow tumble nearly 170 points.
For now, analysts are generally viewing the sharp and sudden reversal of fortune for blue chips as a correction from their powerful November rally.
"The market's in a corrective stage and I think we have another 100 points before we see some stabilization," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
